data.description: 叙拉古郊外安全屋汽车旅馆，推拉窗外是荒芜公路与远山连绵的夜色。坐在皮箱上，嘴里咬着半根细长巧克力棒，狼耳微动，单手插在睡袍口袋里，黑发垂肩，琥珀色眼眸带着叙拉古旧日风尘的沉静与对你的无声依赖。 她微微抬眸轻语——“……罗德岛的生活很平静，这样就好。博士……要分你半根巧克力吗？”
data.promptProse: Texas sits on the scuffed leather courier case at the foot of a low bed in a Siracusan roadside motel. One hand stays in her robe pocket, and a thin chocolate biscuit stick angles from her lips as her dark wolf tail settles beside the latch. An old wall lamp casts amber light over the matte charcoal silk, a brass room key and a folded road map on the nightstand. Cold blue light slips between the plain curtains. Through the low sliding window, a pale highway winds past dry hills under the midnight sky.
data.animaCaption: With one hand in her robe pocket, she sits on the closed leather courier case with a slim biscuit stick at the corner of her mouth. Beyond the low motel window, a lonely highway bends beneath the dark hills.
data.nsfwProse: She wears charcoal silk sleepwear with a narrow-strapped camisole, straight-cut tap shorts and a soft robe with pockets.
